sources.entry: JSON-Splora - GUI for editing, visualizing, and manipulating JSON data.

summary.one_liner: JSON-Splora is an Electron desktop GUI for editing, visualizing, and manipulating JSON data using jq or JavaScript filters.
summary.what_it_does: The app provides a CodeMirror-based editor where input is parsed as json5, so comments and relaxed JSON syntax are accepted. Once the input is valid, a filter window appears below it, and an output panel to the right updates live as the input or filter changes. Filters are first evaluated as JavaScript using the form output = x${filter}, and if that fails the app falls back to jq. Input can come from a URL that returns JSON, a dragged-and-dropped or opened file, or plain text. A command-line launcher named jsplora can open a file directly.
use_cases: Editing and cleaning up JSON files with comments
Filtering JSON with jq expressions interactively
Inspecting JSON fetched from a URL
Viewing live output of JSON queries while typing
notable: Filters run as JavaScript first, with automatic fallback to jq
Accepts json5 input, so comments and relaxed syntax work
Live-updating output panel as input or filter changes
Accepts URLs, dropped files, or plain text as input
caveats: Requires Node.js version 6 or later for installation
Package was renamed from JSON-Splora to json-splora on npm; the old name is deprecated
